title: Restore bronze_epi: Yale EPI CSV URLs now serve HTML, pipeline red since 2026-09-25
description: Measured 2026-10-16 (read-only): all 22 scheduled orchestrator runs from 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-16 FAILED at bronze_epi with 'ParserError: Error tokenizing data. C error: Expected 1 fields in line 15, saw 2' (latest run 342de295, errorCode 2451). curl on https://epi.yale.edu/downloads/epi2024results.csv and .../epi2024weights.csv returns HTTP 200 text/html, a 30,621-byte page titled 'EPI Downloads | Environmental Performance Index', with no redirect and no CSV link in the static HTML. The notebook passes response.text to pd.read_csv (notebook-content.py L133; the weights file at L275) without checking the content type, and its 404 branch never fires on this soft-404. Every downstream activity (bronze_to_silver_cleaning, silver_to_gold, data_quality_checks) has been Skipped since then, so the gold layer is frozen at the 2026-09-24 run. Do: (1) find where Yale now publishes the 2024 results and weights files, or decide to pin the static 2024 vintage in a location we control. Choosing between a live URL and a pinned copy is a design choice: hold it in decisions_pending for Erik. (2) Add a guard that runs before parsing, for both files: reject a non-CSV Content-Type or an HTML body with a named error that cites the URL and the content type. (3) Add a local test of that guard (loading the notebook's own functions where possible). (4) Update spec L216/L261/L860/L1497 via /iterate if the source mechanism changes. (5) Erik confirms the next scheduled run completes and the gold tables advance past 2026-09-24.
acceptanceCriteria: bronze_ingest_epi validates each download before parsing: a non-CSV Content-Type or an HTML body raises a named error citing the URL and content type (no pandas ParserError path).
A local test exercises the guard against an HTML soft-404 body and a valid CSV body, loading the notebook's own function where possible.
The EPI source mechanism is decided by Erik and implemented, with spec text updated via /iterate if the mechanism changes.
A scheduled (or on-demand) orchestrator run completes all 10 activities, and gold tables advance past 2026-09-24, confirmed on live evidence.

issues.description: tests/_notebook_loader.py L37 (extra_globals docstring) still says 'Only the FunctionDefs are compiled'; since this change, ClassDefs are compiled too.

docs/epi_wgi_ingestion.md keeps original research sketches pointing at epi.yale.edu/downloads (L81, L101-103, L600, L658, L685). The L41 banner marks only the URL tables as retired, and the check_for_updates() sketch at L685 treats requests.head(...).status_code == 200 as 'new data available', which is the soft-404 trap this task documents.
reference_data/epi/README.md Provenance names the weights snapshot (20260814071704) but not the results snapshot the same id_ request resolves to (20260424222356).

The guard's HTML sniff matches only '<!doctype html' or '<html' in the first 2 KB, so an HTML fragment without either still gets through. That covers the measured failure mode, and such a body would then fail the notebook's own named schema check; informational only.
